evals.prompt: Our tokens.json has 140 flat entries like primary-blue: #0057FF, grey-400: #9CA3AF, spacing-16: 16px. We need light and dark modes and DTCG format. Our CLAUDE.md requires 4 tiers: core, semantic, component, breakpoint. Propose the architecture and migration.
evals.expected_output: An architecture that keeps the project's 4-tier model (it takes precedence), semantic names without raw values, modes at the semantic tier, DTCG examples with $value/$type and aliases, a contrast table that flags grey-400 on white at about 2.54:1 as unusable for text, and a migration table with deprecation aliases instead of deletions.
assertions: The four project tiers are kept instead of a generic three-tier model
No semantic token name contains a palette step or value
Contrast for #9CA3AF on white is computed near 2.54:1 and flagged for text
Old tokens are kept as deprecated aliases with a removal plan
